name: NYCHA Citywide Special Events
description:
This dataset lists special events held by the New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA), with 368 sampled rows and four columns. Each row records an event title (such as a holiday party, training academy session, or information session), the location where it took place (about 8% of locations are missing), and a start time given as a date and timestamp. A recurrence flag marks whether an event repeats, with about 6% of rows flagged as recurring and the rest as one-time events. Titles and locations are free text, so many entries are unique, and some titles repeat across different dates.

The data could be used to explore the types and timing of NYCHA community and resident events, identify common venues or recurring programs, analyze seasonal patterns in scheduling, or build a public events calendar. It could also support reporting on outreach activities and how often events are held at particular locations.
